title: Odd-prime-power periodicity conjecture
exact_target: Determine the exact starting point and period of the Euler-number sequence modulo every odd prime power; the original two predictions are recorded with their later source context.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 9100001 (AMR-090-0001). CC BY 4.0.

Berke G\"ule\c{c}, \emph{Modular periodicity of the Euler up/down numbers at odd prime powers}, arXiv:2608.27058v2 (2026) Theorems 5.9 and 6.4.
